description.zh-CN: 在岛上加一个页面，列出一个公开仓库的未关闭 issue，点一条就在浏览器里打开。不需要令牌，仓库在设置里填。演示列表模板。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: Adds an island page listing the open issues of a public repository; click one to open it in the browser. No token needed; set the repository in the settings. Shows the list template. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.

description.zh-CN: 换歌时在岛上提示正在播放的歌曲。演示敏感权限：第一次读取播放信息时，岛上会先问你是否允许。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: Shows the new song on the island when the track changes. Shows a sensitive permission: the first time it reads what is playing, the island asks you first. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.

description.zh-CN: 按 Ctrl+Alt+P 或在待办上右键开始一个番茄钟，计时显示在岛上的番茄钟页面和折叠条上，结束时在岛上提示，可以点“再来一轮”。完成的轮数保存在插件存储里。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: Press Ctrl+Alt+P or right-click a todo to start a pomodoro; the countdown shows on its island page and the collapsed bar, and when it ends the island shows a message with One more round. Finished rounds are kept in plugin storage. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.

description.zh-CN: 待办变化时在日志里记录未完成待办的数量；点“写入摘要”会把未完成的待办追加到每日笔记。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行，不需要另外安装任何东西。
description.en: Logs how many todos are open whenever they change; Write digest appends the open todos to the daily note. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows, so nothing else needs installing.
